subject: Following up on VPC/private deployment interest (next steps)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Bethany Rhodes <bethany.rhodes@acmepayments.com>, Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmepayments.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-20T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up & next steps from today's discovery (VPC/private deployment)

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation. Quick recap + proposed next steps: 

- Recap: We discussed Acme Payments' latency targets for fraud scoring (p95 < 120ms for live transactions), current data residency constraints, and the desire to avoid token exposure to third-party multi-tenant services. 
- Proposal: Based on the security and residency requirements you outlined, I recommended exploring Redwood Private (VPC or on-prem) as the primary path: private control plane, customer-managed networking, and KMS integration for keys. 
- Immediate next steps I suggested:
  1) Share a concise Mutual Action Plan (attached) outlining milestones (POC, security review, pilot, GA).
  2) Intro to our Security lead for a short call to go over SOC 2 / network architecture.
  3) Rough cost estimate for Dedicated capacity vs hosted to inform procurement.

Attachments: redwood-vpc-overview.pdf, mutual-action-plan.xlsx

Would love to schedule a 30-min follow-up with your infra/security counterpart next week to walk the team through the VPC architecture and checklist. My availability: Tue/Wed afternoons PST. If that doesn't work, tell me the best timing and I will coordinate.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0198

---

1) On the KMS integration: can you confirm we can use our AWS KMS keys (we're multi-account)?
2) Ballpark: how different is Dedicated monthly commitment vs hosted in terms of average $/month for the scale we discussed (10M tokens/day)? A range is fine — we'll use it for internal prioritization.

I'll loop in our infrastructure lead if we agree on timing for a security deep-dive.

Best,

Hi Marissa — apologies for the delay. Thanks for the follow-ups and the MAP — helpful framing. Short update from our side: 

- We are very interested in the private deployment option because of the compliance posture, but headcount and budget constraints have pushed this down the roadmap for now. Our current ask is to pause active work and revisit in Q3 (July) when we re-evaluate vendor commitments.
- Can you send a 1-page cost ballpark for Dedicated (monthly committed) vs hosted at the volumes we discussed? That will help procurement with planning.
- Also: please include the SOC 2 report and any standard security whitepapers you have so our security team can do an offline review.

If it helps, feel free to leave the MAP as-is and I can re-open when we kick this back up. Otherwise, let's tentatively plan to reconnect in early July.

Thanks,
Alex Johnson
Director, Infrastructure | Acme Payments
